title.quote: Detection and Evaluation of bias-inducing Features in Machine learning
title.justification: Title as printed on the paper
title.value: Detection and Evaluation of bias-inducing Features in Machine learning

extractions.description: The paper proposes a technique for systematically identifying bias-inducing features in machine learning models by swapping values of single features and pairs of features (feature and mediating variables), and measuring divergence in the model prediction distributions using four distance functions. It validates the approach empirically on four well-known tabular datasets with a logistic regression model, compares feature rankings with SHAP values, and evaluates the impact of removing identified features with and without bias mitigation techniques.

type.quote: We validate our proposed technique by performing multiple experiments using four different well-known datasets.
type.justification: The paper performs empirical experiments on four datasets to validate the proposed technique.
